cases.name: profile-before-microbenchmark
cases.description: The measurement plan chooses a realistic profile before isolating a confirmed hot operation.
cases.prompt: An R report is slow, but the team does not know whether parsing, grouping, or plotting dominates. Design a measurement plan and explain what should and should not be timed.
traps: Begins with a toy microbenchmark of a guessed expression
Treats one elapsed-time result as proof of the bottleneck

assertions.text: Profiles the realistic workload before choosing a focused microbenchmark.
Keeps setup outside the timed expression unless setup is part of the user-visible operation.
Uses representative input shape, size, classes, and missingness.

cases.name: memory-and-correctness
cases.description: The benchmark reports allocation and garbage collection while checking behavioral equivalence.
cases.prompt: Compare two R implementations of a transformation. What evidence should you collect before recommending the faster one?
traps: Accepts different values or attributes because the candidate is faster

assertions.text: Inspects allocation and garbage-collection behavior alongside timing.
Checks output values, types, dimensions, names, classes, and missingness.
Compares across relevant input sizes and states the practical impact.
